messages:
lee: Quick note — published SDK causing 'require is not defined' in Vercel Edge.

anya: Is the app importing the package root or a dist path?

lee: root: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. Crash in edge runtime.

frank: sounds like resolver picked CJS. Our exports map has import/require fields but some bundlers still pick the require path.

anya: Short-term fix: import from dist/esm directly or add an alias to force ESM. Not great DX.

lee: Also noticed types not being discovered in some TS projects. Root "types" set but tsc sometimes ignores it with conditional exports.

frank: Proposed fix: add explicit "./types" export, add a "worker" conditional export, and make ESM the canonical build. I'll open a tiny PR to add a worker target and a note in the changelog.

build-bot: CI: added edge-smoke job (miniflare) to catch this earlier.

anya: Also let's extract the fetch/retry adapter into a single small module used by both bundles so retry semantics don't drift between CJS/ESM. Auth flakes came from that difference.

docs-bot: Docs updated: "Edge runtimes: prefer ESM entrypoints; see troubleshooting for conditional exports and types."

lee: Thanks — filing follow-ups: 1) add worker export + ./types, 2) extract runtime adapter, 3) CI smoke. I'll assign the items.
